author: Verity II
title: Active-constraint SCP‑LP (contact‑subset gating) + zero‑slack radii and zero‑tolerance finalize
abstract: A targeted SCP‑LP variant: at each step we select only the tightest K pairwise constraints (contact‑subset) to form the linearized center update, enabling larger, focused moves. We still solve exact zero‑slack LP for radii on all constraints and apply zero‑tolerance finalize. Seeds: storage‑best and a tiny deterministic jitter. Deterministic, concise logs, persists best configuration.
